title: supervisor UX / production logging failure fixes

PROD-013.title: Very large but plausible meters.
PROD-013.current_failure_evidence: Suspiciously large but positive meter values have no explicit threshold, warning, or confirmation. Shared validation checks negative values and required worker/order/rate fields, but it does not cap or flag large positive meters; the UI number input also lacks a max/suspicious-value confirmation path.
PROD-013.implementation_type: UI confirmation plus shared source helper; no hard block
PROD-013.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Supervisor browser proof should enter a normal value and a suspiciously large shift-total value, confirm the warning, and verify the large value can still save in QA.

PROD-022.title: Change date/shift while draft exists.
PROD-022.expected_behavior: Draft stored under correct date/shift and never submitted to another shift.
PROD-022.current_failure_evidence: Entered loom values remained visible when changing the date, then the date reset to June 22 on save; draft isolation by date was not reliable or clearly communicated.
PROD-022.implementation_type: Risky without runtime draft/date-shift proof; current code keys localStorage by date/shift and resets visible state during transitions, but the row requires browser proof and may need deeper draft state review.
PROD-022.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Browser proof should enter draft values, switch date and shift, refresh, and prove no draft is submitted under another date/shift.

PROD-023.title: Refresh/browser crash with draft.
PROD-023.current_failure_evidence: Draft production meters are persisted and restored from localStorage after refresh/crash, but the supervisor production UI does not explicitly mark restored values as an unsaved draft. The visible helper copy says loading, ready/pending, or all entries ready; repository search found no active supervisor production 'unsaved draft' or 'draft restored' indicator.
PROD-023.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Supervisor browser proof should enter shift meters, refresh before save, verify the restored-unsaved banner appears, then save or clear and verify the indicator is gone.

PROD-029.title: Compare visible “shift meters” terminology with stored synthetic readings.

PROD-029.current_failure_evidence: Production landing-page copy still claims supervisors enter or log meter readings, while the active production model records shift-total meters with synthetic opening/closing values.
PROD-029.matrix_evidence: production landing DOM snapshot on 2026-06-21; repository: app landing copy and supervisor production implementation
PROD-029.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Browser/content review should confirm public landing and setup/help surfaces no longer claim raw opening/closing meter readings.
